description_en: Creates a custom image based on an existing image and starts an image creation task
description_zh: 基于已有镜像创建自定义镜像，并启动镜像制作任务
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center builder-image-by-parent --parent-image-id 'imgc-bp1parent****' --image-create-mode BUILDER_MANUAL --system-disk-size 80 --performance-type CPU --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BuilderImageByParent

parameters.help_en: The name of the new image. Required. The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with http:// or https://. The length is calculated as 3 for each Chinese character and 1 for each other character. The total length must be 2 to 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: 新镜像名称。必须提供。必须以字母或中文开头，可包含字母、数字、中文、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、英文句点（.）和短划线（-），不能以 http:// 或 https:// 开头。长度按中文字符计 3、其他字符计 1 计算，合计为 2～64
parameters.name: image_name

parameters.help_en:
The package type of the image. Keep it consistent with the selected parent image and creation scenario. Valid values:

Ecs: ECS instance image.
Vhd: VHD application image.
Container: Container image.
Ecs_Container: ECS and container combined image.
K8s_Node: Kubernetes node image.

This operation does not provide the BaseImageId parameter. You cannot explicitly specify the Vhd or Container type that requires a base image to be configured separately
parameters.help_zh:
镜像封装类型。请与所选父镜像及制作场景保持一致。可选值：

Ecs：ECS 实例镜像。
Vhd：VHD 应用镜像。
Container：容器镜像。
Ecs_Container：ECS 与容器组合镜像。
K8s_Node：Kubernetes 节点镜像。

当前接口没有提供 BaseImageId 参数，不能显式指定需要另行配置基础镜像的 Vhd 或 Container 类型
parameters.name: package_type

parameters.help_en:
The business type to which the image belongs. Required. Valid values:

1: Basic product.
2: Personal cloud.
3: Cloud office.
4: Cloud Flow.
10: Personal edition.
20: Business edition.
60: Linggou team edition
parameters.help_zh:
镜像所属业务类型。必须提供。可选值：

1：基础产品。
2：个人云。
3：云上办公室。
4：云 Flow。
10：个人版。
20：商业版。
60：灵构团队版
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en:
The product to which the image belongs. Required. Use an activated product and keep it consistent with the selected parent image. Valid values:

CloudGame: Cloud game.
CloudApp: Wuying Cloud App.
CloudBrowser: Secure browser.
CloudDesktop: Wuying Cloud Computer.
ImageBuilder: Image creation resource.
ImageValidate: Image validation resource.
AndroidCloud: Android cloud.
GpuRender: GPU rendering.
AndroidGpuRender: Android cloud GPU rendering.
WuyingServer: Enterprise edition workstation.
GpuProxy: GPU remote rendering proxy.
GpuCache: GPU remote rendering cache.
AIAgent: AI agent service.
HostedDesktop: Hosted computer.
WuyingWorkstation: Personal edition container workstation.
WuyingWorkstationBusiness: Business edition container workstation.
WuyingWorkstationTeam: Linggou container workstation team edition
parameters.help_zh:
镜像所属产品。必须提供。请使用已开通的产品，且与所选父镜像保持一致。可选值：

CloudGame：云游戏。
CloudApp：无影云应用。
CloudBrowser：安全浏览器。
CloudDesktop：无影云电脑。
ImageBuilder：镜像制作资源。
ImageValidate：镜像验证资源。
AndroidCloud：安卓云。
GpuRender：GPU 渲染。
AndroidGpuRender：安卓云 GPU 渲染。
WuyingServer：企业版工作站。
GpuProxy：GPU 远程渲染代理。
GpuCache：GPU 远程渲染缓存。
AIAgent：AI Agent 服务。
HostedDesktop：托管电脑。
WuyingWorkstation：个人版容器工作站。
WuyingWorkstationBusiness：商业版容器工作站。
WuyingWorkstationTeam：灵构容器工作站团队版
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en:
The language of the image. Valid values:

zh-CN: Simplified Chinese.
zh-HK: Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong).
en-US: English.
ja-JP: Japanese.
CN: Compatible value for Simplified Chinese.
EN: Compatible value for English.
JP: Compatible value for Japanese.
CN-HK: Compatible value for Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong)
parameters.help_zh:
镜像语言。可选值：

zh-CN：简体中文。
zh-HK：繁体中文（香港）。
en-US：英语。
ja-JP：日语。
CN：简体中文的兼容取值。
EN：英语的兼容取值。
JP：日语的兼容取值。
CN-HK：繁体中文（香港）的兼容取值
parameters.name: language

parameters.example: 包含办公应用及标准配置的业务镜像
parameters.help_en: The description of the new image, which facilitates subsequent queries and differentiation of images
parameters.help_zh: 新镜像的用途说明，便于后续查询和区分镜像
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent image used to create the new image. Required. You can call ListImage to query the ID. An available distribution record of the parent image must exist in the region where the image is created
parameters.help_zh: 用于制作新镜像的父镜像 ID。必填。可调用 ListImage 查询；制作地域必须存在该父镜像的可用分发记录
parameters.name: parent_image_id

parameters.help_en:
The extended properties of the image. Both keys and values are strings. This parameter can be omitted when no extended configuration is required.

The property key for the driver list is DRIVER_LIST, and the value is a JSON string of an array of driver IDs. We recommend that you specify drivers by using DriverIdList. If both DriverIdList and PropertyMap.DRIVER_LIST are specified, DriverIdList takes precedence. Specify other extended properties only when their purposes and values are confirmed
parameters.help_zh:
镜像扩展属性。键和值均为字符串；无需扩展配置时可省略。

驱动列表对应的属性键为 DRIVER_LIST，值为驱动 ID 数组的 JSON 字符串。建议通过 DriverIdList 指定驱动；同时传入 DriverIdList 和 PropertyMap.DRIVER_LIST 时，以 DriverIdList 为准。其他扩展属性仅在已确认其用途及取值时填写
parameters.name: property_map

parameters.help_en:
The image creation mode. Use the following mode:

BUILDER_MANUAL: Manually enter the creation environment to install applications and configure the image
parameters.help_zh:
镜像制作模式。当前请使用以下模式：

BUILDER_MANUAL：手动进入制作环境安装应用并配置镜像
parameters.name: image_create_mode

parameters.help_en: The capacity of the system cloud disk in the creation environment. Unit: GiB. The capacity cannot be smaller than the system cloud disk capacity required by the parent image, and must meet the disk requirements of the selected resource specifications
parameters.help_zh: 制作环境的系统盘容量。单位：GiB。容量不能小于父镜像所需的系统盘容量，并应满足所选资源规格的磁盘要求
parameters.name: system_disk_size

parameters.help_en: The capacity of the data cloud disk in the creation environment. Unit: GiB. Specify this parameter when a data cloud disk is required, and ensure that it meets the disk requirements of the selected resource specifications
parameters.help_zh: 制作环境的数据盘容量。单位：GiB。需要数据盘时填写，并满足所选资源规格的磁盘要求
parameters.name: data_disk_size

parameters.help_en:
The computing type of the creation resources.

CPU: Uses CPU compute resources.
GPU: Uses GPU compute resources
parameters.help_zh:
制作资源的计算类型。

CPU：使用 CPU 计算资源。
GPU：使用 GPU 计算资源
parameters.name: performance_type

fields.help_en: The resource content corresponding to ResourceType. For the URL type, enter or return an accessible resource URL
fields.help_zh: 与 ResourceType 对应的资源内容。URL 类型填写或返回可访问的资源地址
fields.name: resource

fields.help_en:
The provision method of the resource content. Valid values:

HOSTED: Hosted resource.
TEXT: Text resource.
URL: Resource provided through a URL
fields.help_zh:
资源内容的提供方式。可选值：

HOSTED：托管资源。
TEXT：文本资源。
URL：通过 URL 提供的资源
fields.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The list of resources required for image creation, such as the download URLs of applications to be installed. A maximum of 100 items are supported. The ResourceType and Resource of each item must correspond to each other
parameters.help_zh: 镜像制作所需的资源列表，例如待安装应用的下载地址。最多 100 项；每项的 ResourceType 与 Resource 必须相互对应
parameters.name: resource_list

parameters.help_en:
The running mode of the image creation environment. Valid values:

NORMAL: Normal running mode.
COMPATIBLE: Compatible running mode
parameters.help_zh:
镜像制作环境的运行模式。可选值：

NORMAL：普通运行模式。
COMPATIBLE：兼容运行模式
parameters.name: run_mode

parameters.help_en: The display name of the new image version, which is used to differentiate different versions of the same image
parameters.help_zh: 新镜像版本的显示名称，用于区分同一镜像的不同版本
parameters.name: version_name

parameters.help_en: The operating system distribution information of the image. Enter the distribution identifier that is consistent with the parent image used
parameters.help_zh: 镜像操作系统发行版信息。填写与所用父镜像一致的发行版标识
parameters.name: distro

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the image is created. The selected parent image must have been distributed to this region. Available regions are also affected by the region configurations of the account and product
parameters.help_zh: 镜像制作地域 ID。所选父镜像必须已分发到该地域；可用地域还受账号和产品的地域配置影响
parameters.name: source_region

parameters.help_en:
The list of driver IDs used when creating the image. A maximum of 200 items are supported. When you need to specify drivers, enter the IDs of existing drivers that are applicable to the target image.

If PropertyMap.DRIVER_LIST is also specified, this parameter overwrites the driver list in it
parameters.help_zh:
制作镜像时使用的驱动 ID 列表，最多 200 项。需要指定驱动时填写已存在且适用于目标镜像的驱动 ID。

同时指定 PropertyMap.DRIVER_LIST 时，本参数会覆盖其中的驱动列表
parameters.name: driver_id_list

parameters.help_en: The ID of the office network used by the creation resources. Specify this parameter when a specific office network is required, and ensure that it is consistent with the creation region
parameters.help_zh: 制作资源使用的办公网络 ID。需要使用指定办公网络时填写，并与制作地域保持一致
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the node specifications for the creation resources. You can invoke ListNodeInstanceType to query the ID. Select a specification that is active in the creation region and under the associated product, and meets the CPU or GPU computing requirements
parameters.help_zh: 制作资源的节点规格 ID。可通过 ListNodeInstanceType 查询；应选择在制作地域和所属产品下可用、且满足 CPU 或 GPU 计算要求的规格
parameters.name: node_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The list of vSwitch IDs used by the creation resources. A maximum of 100 items are supported. The vSwitches must belong to the selected office network and be located in the creation region
parameters.help_zh: 制作资源使用的交换机 ID 列表，最多 100 项。交换机须属于所选办公网络并位于制作地域
parameters.name: vswitch_id_list

schema.description_en: The response of this API invocation
schema.description_zh: 本次 API 调用的响应结果

Code.description_en: The error code. This parameter is returned when the request fails. A successful response may not contain this parameter
Code.description_zh: 错误码。请求失败时返回；成功响应可能不包含该字段

Data.description_en: The business data returned by this operation
Data.description_zh: 本次操作返回的业务数据

ImageId.description_en: The image ID, which is used for subsequent queries or modifications of the image
ImageId.description_zh: 镜像 ID，用于后续查询或修改镜像
ImageId.title_en: 系统镜像id有含义，自定义镜像自动生成
ImageId.title_zh: 系统镜像id有含义，自定义镜像自动生成

TaskId.description_en: The task ID, which can be used to call GetTask to query the task status
TaskId.description_zh: 任务 ID，可用于调用 GetTask 查询任务状态

VersionId.description_en: The image version ID, which is used to query or manage the specified version of the image
VersionId.description_zh: 镜像版本 ID，用于查询或操作该镜像的指定版本

Message.description_en: The error or result message. This parameter describes the cause when the request fails. A successful response may not contain this parameter
Message.description_zh: 错误或结果提示。请求失败时用于说明原因，成功响应可能不包含该字段
Message.example: The maximum number of builders is reached.

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. You can provide this value for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，排查问题时可提供该值

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is processed successfully. A value of true indicates that the request is processed successfully. To check whether the asynchronous task is completed, you must query the task status separately
Success.description_zh: 请求是否处理成功。true 表示本次请求处理成功；异步任务是否完成须另外查询任务状态
